headline: Ahold Delhaize confirms cyberattack disrupted US and European systems
summary: Grocery giant Ahold Delhaize confirmed that a cyberattack disrupted services at stores across the US and Europe, forcing systems offline. It is described as the company's second major security incident in two years.

claims.statement: Ahold Delhaize confirmed a cyberattack disrupted its US and European systems.

sources.quote: Grocery giant Ahold Delhaize confirms cyberattack forced US and European systems offline
Ahold Delhaize, one of the world's largest food retail chains, confirmed that last week's cyberattack disrupted services at stores across Europe and the United States.

claims.statement: The incident is the company's second security 'snafu' in two years.

sources.quote: Second security snafu in two years
